title: Visual sensitivity is not claim retractability: persistence-aware credit assignment for multimodal reinforcement learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.36572v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has been extended to Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs), and perception-aware methods further encourage policies to rely on visual evidence. Yet relying on the image does not guarantee that visual claims are supported by it. Before RL training, 27.81% of the correctly answered responses of Qwen2.5-VL-7B on four multimodal reasoning benchmarks contain at least one direct visual claim that the image does not support. Since outcome-level RL rewards each response as a whole, these claims inherit the positive credit of the correct answer. We introduce a fixed-rollout counterfactual diagnostic that re-scores the same response under an intervened image to separate Evidence-Function Sensitivity (EFS), how strongly the model's predictions change, from claim persistence, whether the model keeps supporting the same claim rather than retracting it. The diagnostic reveals Sensitivity-Persistence

translated_title: 视觉敏感性不等于主张可撤回性：面向多模态强化学习的持续性感知信用分配
translated_abstract: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已被扩展到大型视觉-语言模型（LVLM），感知感知方法进一步鼓励策略依赖视觉证据。然而，依赖图像并不能保证视觉主张真正得到图像的支持。在强化学习训练之前，Qwen2.5-VL-7B 在四个多模态推理基准上正确回答的回复中有 27.81% 包含至少一个图像并不支持的直接视觉主张。由于结果级强化学习将每个回复作为一个整体进行奖励，这些主张便继承了正确答案的正向信用。我们引入了一种固定 rollout 的反事实诊断方法，在干预后的图像下对同一回复重新评分，以区分证据函数敏感性（EFS，即模型预测变化的强烈程度）与主张持续性（claim persistence，即模型是继续支持同一主张还是将其撤回）。该诊断揭示了敏感性-持续性
tldr: 该论文提出一种固定 rollout 的反事实诊断方法，将证据函数敏感性与主张持续性解耦，揭示出结果级强化学习会让图像不支持但答案正确的视觉主张继承正向奖励信用的问题，并据此提出持续性感知的信用分配方法。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a fixed-rollout counterfactual diagnostic that decouples Evidence-Function Sensitivity from claim persistence, revealing that outcome-level RL lets image-unsupported visual claims inherit positive credit from correct answers, and introduces persistence-aware credit assignment for multimodal reinforcement learning.
